## 🏋️ Fitness Coach App

**4 bottom navigation tabs:**

| Tab | Features |
|------|------|
| **Workout** | This week's stats summary (workout count, duration, sets), workout plan list (filterable by type), one-tap start workout |
| **Plans** | Workout plan CRUD (create/edit/delete), each plan contains an exercise list (sets × reps × duration × rest time all configurable), exercise management (add/remove exercises) |
| **Timer** | Exercise-timer / rest-timer dual modes, 6 quick presets (30/45/60/90/120/180 sec), custom duration input, start/pause/reset controls, haptic feedback when the countdown hits zero |
| **Records** | Workout history list, total count stats, record detail view, record deletion |

**Closed-loop workout flow:**
1. Create a workout plan under 「Plans」 and add exercises (bench press, squat, etc.)
2. Tap a plan under 「Workout」 → enter workout mode → log it set by set
3. Finish the workout → a record is automatically generated and saved under 「Records」
4. During a workout you can open 「Timer」 anytime to help time your exercises

4 workout plans (Upper-body Strength, Legs, Cardio Recovery, Core Training) and 3 workout records are preloaded as demo data.
